typesAndFullValidation.reason: Root requested hosted gates and no local heavyweight TypeScript/full-unit validation.

interruptions.stage: Fresh candidate-only process before first ten-group progress output; no semantic mismatch reported

attemptedCandidate.completedGroupsNote: No ten-group progress output or candidate checkpoint survived; no partial result count is asserted.
attemptedCandidate.continuationPolicy: No further local retry. Root may run a separately identified hosted full-corpus oracle and gates.

scope: Correctness through the actual source planner and workers with a fixed two-CPU/eight-GiB navigator hint, plus gross allocation hypothesis only. No complete-import speed or peak-memory claim; current four-CPU production JMdict has 12 groups, this oracle has 8.

allocationScope.counts: Gross source-level operations for eligible native-accepted representatives, not net heap bytes, peak memory, or complete-import time.
allocationScope.columnar56be: Avoids copied/transported projected row+wrapper pairs and retention/transport of per-row path arrays. The native helper still constructs a temporary one-element path array before flattening.
allocationScope.early037: Additionally avoids the earlier compatibility row and its wrapper (2 plain objects), glossary/content subarray views (2 view objects), and construction of native [path] (1 tiny array). Original key decoding/views, owned diagnostic bytes, path strings and per-group builders remain.
allocationScope.noDoubleCounting: The earlier raw objects and later copied/transported objects are distinct phases. The same native path array is counted once as a newly avoided construction, not as another #907 allocation removal.

independentReview.mode: Read-only source and focused regression inspection; no additional heavy validators
points: Original source token diagnostics preserve escaped and lone-surrogate strings and empty-reading aliases.
Native image projection reads only the bounded live source and stack locals.
Diagnostic bytes are owned before metadata scratch reuse.
Accepted native and rejected/raw rows form disjoint ordered streams; merge restores source order and within-row byte aliases.
nativeProjectionAttempted is stripped at the worker copying boundary.
Number decoding is skipped only after final fused validated columns exist.

oraclePlannerConfiguration.meaning: Actual production source-planner and worker code under an explicitly fixed two-CPU, eight-GiB navigator hint. These group counts do not describe the current four-CPU production configuration.
